Stock market news | Crystal Crop Protection lists at ₹278 with 2.2% premium

Crystal Crop Protection listed on the NSE at ₹278 and on the BSE at ₹280 on 26 November 2026, trading at roughly a 2-3% premium to its issue price of ₹272. The IPO attracted strong demand, with overall subscription of 17 times and the retail tranche subscribed 9.26 times, indicating investor confidence in the agro-chemical sector.
